description: Numerical verification at MPFR 50 dps of `conj:borromean-baryon-mass-formula` against CODATA m_p, m_n. Canonical formula post-PR #1080: m(K) = m_e × Geom_full(K, q₀), a single per-knot Geom call.  Geom_full = (Vol(𝓑₃)/ℏ_q²) × linking_weight, where linking_weight is the PROVED Family A categorical identity (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (terminates exactly at h²; Lean: `lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean`).  Family A applies to the baryon class uniformly, giving m_avg^pred = m_e × Geom_full(𝓑₃, q₀) ≈ 966 MeV at q_0 — about 2.89 % above the CODATA mean (m_p + m_n)/2 ≈ 938.92 MeV. The proton-neutron mass difference is then supplied categorically by the substrate flavor-split closed form Δm/M_N = ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3 (`prop:flavor-split-substrate`, PR #690), giving m_p^pred ≈ 965.38 MeV (vs CODATA 938.272088, ~2.89 % off) and m_n^pred ≈ 966.71 MeV (vs CODATA 939.565421, ~2.89 % off).  The substrate Δm/M_N ratio itself matches CODATA to ~305 ppm (0.030 %) — framework-proved, no fit.  The prior CAL-4 fit (2.4599527869, 2.4633436333, 5.4 ppm tautological match) was removed in 2026-05-22 per the conjecture-falsification audit and is retained ONLY as audit-only `linking_weight_*_fitted_from_codata_AUDIT_ONLY` columns.  Per PR #1063, the ~2.89 % residual is now framed as a Geom_full(𝓑₃) categorical-exactness refinement gap at h² order, NOT as a separate λ_scale closure.

parameters.geom_full_decomposition: Geom_full = (Vol(𝓑₃)/ℏ_q²) × linking_weight; linking_weight = (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (PROVED Family A categorical identity)

class_uniform_m_avg.formula: m_avg = m_e · Geom_full(𝓑₃, q₀)  (PR #1080, before flavor split)
class_uniform_m_avg.geom_full_decomposition: Geom_full = (Vol(𝓑₃)/ℏ_q²) × linking_weight; linking_weight = (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (PROVED canonical Wedderburn — Family A)

proton.formula: m_p = m_avg_pred · (1 − Δm/M_N / 2), with m_avg_pred = m_e · Geom_full(𝓑₃, q₀) and Δm/M_N from flavor_split_subleading

neutron.formula: m_n = m_avg_pred · (1 + Δm/M_N / 2), with m_avg_pred = m_e · Vol(B_3)/ℏ_q² · λ_Y and Δm/M_N from flavor_split_subleading

proton_neutron_split.note: The pn split is now categorically derived: Δm = m_avg_pred · (ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3) via prop:flavor-split-substrate / flavor_split_subleading. The rel_diff vs CODATA inherits the Family A m_avg gap (~3 %); the substrate flavor-ratio Δm/M_N is matched to ~305 ppm (~0.030 %) independently — see substrate_flavor_split.ratio_ppm_vs_codata.

scale_gap_resolution.conclusion: Geom_full(𝓑₃, q₀) ≈ 1836 IS the 1700× scale factor missing from the single-level Markov-trace m_p chain. The Borromean tower formula closes the gap to ~2.89 % on m_avg; substrate flavor split (PR #690) supplies Δm/M_N to ~305 ppm independently.

caveats: Canonical formula post-PR #1080: m(K) = m_e × Geom_full(K, q₀), a single Geom call per knot.  Geom_full decomposes as (Vol(𝓑₃)/ℏ_q²) × linking_weight, with linking_weight = (3q² + 4 + 3q⁻²)/4 = 5/2 + (3/4)h² (PROVED Family A categorical Wedderburn identity, Lean: `lambda-scale-substrate-form.lean`).  There is no separate λ_scale constant — older docs called the linking-weight component λ_scale before it was absorbed into Geom_full.  The prior CAL-4 literals 2.4599527869 / 2.4633436333 are retained only as audit-only comparison columns.  The proton-neutron mass ratio Δm/M_N is the substrate-pure closed form from `prop:flavor-split-substrate` (PR #690): ℏ_q² · h_q · [2]_q · (1 + ℏ_q³) / 3, which matches CODATA to ~305 ppm (~0.030 %).  The remaining ~2.89 % gap in the absolute m_avg scale is now framed (per PR #1063) as a Geom_full(𝓑₃) categorical-exactness refinement gap at h² order, NOT as a separate λ_scale closure.
